data.body:
[P2] Preserve a bounded clock hold for running detached work

An abandoned child can still supply a callback that its live caller awaits. For example, the child waits 1 hour, then runs a callback-sending step involving short real I/O in parallel with a longer durable wait; the caller races that callback against a 2-hour wait. Removing the child from `participants` lets processing its longer wait call `advance()` while the callback step is running. The clock jumps to the caller’s deadline, allowing the timeout branch to win before the callback arrives. Previously, the running step held the clock. This changes the live caller’s result, beyond shifting the abandoned child’s timestamps. Retain a bounded hold while detached invocations run, expiring it for never-settling work, and add a regression covering this callback/deadline race.
